city.blacklight.hydra_required: Grow and feed living tissue to maturity; its hydra opens the route to the Blacklight dimension.
screen.blacklight.organ_progress: Best specimen: %s / 3  Upgrade: %s / 3  Next rank: %s EP
screen.blacklight.organ_acquire: Consume a developed primary organ to obtain its specimen. Quality I/II/III opens the corresponding upgrade ranks. Mature hosts need 15%% health or less; quality II+ also needs broken protective tissue and 10%% health or less. New specimen qualities grant a one-time EP bonus. Repeat specimens retain ordinary resource rewards. Research and upgrades survive death.
upgrade.blacklight.organ_muscle.desc: Each rank increases direct melee damage by 5%% in Prototype mode, up to 15%%. Consume a muscle-specialized host to obtain a specimen.
upgrade.blacklight.organ_carapace.desc: Each rank reduces ordinary incoming damage by 5%% in Prototype mode, up to 15%%. Consume a carapace-specialized host to obtain a specimen.
upgrade.blacklight.organ_jaw.desc: Each rank increases consume healing by 10%% and biomass by 5%%. EP yield is unchanged. Consume a jaw-specialized host to obtain a specimen.
upgrade.blacklight.organ_grasp.desc: Each rank adds 0.5 blocks to creature grab range, up to 1.5 blocks, including Whipfist grabs. Consume a grasp-specialized host to obtain a specimen.
upgrade.blacklight.organ_crest.desc: Each rank adds 0.1 knockback resistance in Prototype mode, up to 0.3. Consume a crest-specialized host to obtain a specimen.
message.blacklight.organ_discovered: Primary organ research: %s, quality %s specimen; first discovery +%s EP
hud.blacklight.host_growth_cost: Accelerating this stage: about %s nutrients · increasing each stage
tooltip.blacklight.blacklight_sample.1: Found in a frozen research station. Use to throw; shatters on impact and releases Blacklight.
tooltip.blacklight.blacklight_sample.2: 16-block exposure radius, strongest near impact. Shatter at your feet to awaken; other players are unaffected.
message.blacklight.infected: The Blacklight virus has reconstructed your body.
message.blacklight.vial_burst: Virus ampoule shattered: %s creatures newly exposed
command.blacklight.infected: Blacklight infection applied; press B to toggle Prototype mode.
message.blacklight.not_infected: You are not infected with Blacklight
message.blacklight.groundspike_charge_sh: The claw has not reached the ground yet
message.blacklight.dashing_slice_locked: Dashing Slice upgrade is not unlocked
message.blacklight.tuner_singleplayer_on: Movement tuning is server-controlled; the tuner is limited to private singleplayer worlds
message.blacklight.prototype_mode_requir: Blacklight infection is required before entering Prototype mode
message.blacklight.prototype_mode_enable: Prototype mode enabled; vanilla survival interactions are locked
message.blacklight.prototype_mode_disabl: Vanilla mode enabled; all vanilla controls are restored
message.blacklight.survival_locked: Mining, placement and item use are unavailable in Blacklight mode; item and experience pickup remain available.
message.blacklight.upgrade_denied: Cannot unlock %s (needs %s EP, prerequisite missing, or already owned)
upgrade.blacklight.jump_1.desc: Launch velocity ×1.10, subject to the final launch limit
upgrade.blacklight.jump_2.desc: Launch velocity ×1.20, subject to the final launch limit
upgrade.blacklight.jump_3.desc: Launch velocity ×1.30, subject to the final launch limit
upgrade.blacklight.damage.desc: All claw skills deal more damage
upgrade.blacklight.dashing_slice.desc: Enhances the claw dashing slice attack.
message.blacklight.consume_weaken: Targets with at least 50 maximum health must be weakened to 15% health to grab or consume
upgrade.blacklight.hammerfists.desc: Heavy fists for crushing attacks and consumption.
upgrade.blacklight.blade.desc: A biological blade for slashes, thrusts and rushes.
upgrade.blacklight.whipfist.desc: Ranged lashes and pulling grabs up to 12 blocks away. Sweeper can strike a point-blank target up to nine times.
message.blacklight.grab_busy: Finish the current action before grabbing
message.blacklight.grab_ground: Grab ordinary mobs from the ground
screen.blacklight.wheel.hint: Hold %s to aim / release to equip / RMB cancels
screen.blacklight.wheel.blade: Blade: cuts / running thrust / RMB cleave
screen.blacklight.wheel.whipfist: Whipfist: lash / RMB sweep / E snare
screen.blacklight.wheel.none: Retract / E grab / RMB consume held target
message.blacklight.hive_cleared: Hive destroyed. Infected hosts gain 180 EP and 250 biomass.
upgrade.blacklight.vitality.desc: Increase infected base maximum health to 150. Other health bonuses still stack.
upgrade.blacklight.regeneration.desc: After 8 seconds without damage, recover 5 health every 5 seconds.
upgrade.blacklight.assimilation.desc: Restore 35% more health, consume large targets at 20% health and envelop in 2.4 seconds.
advancement.blacklight.root.desc: Level a snowy cartographer to apprentice, then buy a station map for 12 emeralds and a compass.
advancement.blacklight.awakening.desc: Use a recovered sample to awaken. Press B for Blacklight mode, E to grab and right-click to consume.
advancement.blacklight.first_consume.des: Below 50 maximum health: grab directly. At least 50: weaken to 15% health. Press E to grab, then right-click to consume.
advancement.blacklight.first_evolution.d: Press U and spend biomass on a biology upgrade.
advancement.blacklight.hive_breaker.desc: Explore new terrain, defeat its guards and destroy a hive core.
screen.blacklight.wheel.muscle_mass: LMB: punches | RMB: uppercut | Sprint: rush
screen.blacklight.wheel.shield: Absorbs frontal hits until broken; regenerates automatically. Select again to retract.
screen.blacklight.wheel.armor: Armour: 47.5% physical resistance, 25% slower; no glide or low-obstacle parkour.
screen.blacklight.wheel.thermal_vision: Thermal vision: warm living silhouettes against cold surroundings within 24 blocks.
screen.blacklight.wheel.infected_vision: Infected vision: orange-red infected and cool ordinary life within 32 blocks.
upgrade.blacklight.muscle_mass.desc: Fast punches, uppercut and stronger throws. Doubles shared physical-skill damage; does not double-count dedicated punches or Devastators.
upgrade.blacklight.shield.desc: 250 independent shield points absorb frontal hits. Overflow damages health; rebuilds after 10.25 seconds. Toggling never refills it.
upgrade.blacklight.armor.desc: 47.5% physical resistance and greater stability; 25% slower, with no glide or low-obstacle parkour.
upgrade.blacklight.thermal_vision.desc: Warm living silhouettes within 24 blocks, respecting solid terrain. Coexists with weapons and defence.
upgrade.blacklight.infected_vision.desc: Distinguishes infected from ordinary life within 32 blocks. Mutually exclusive with thermal vision.
upgrade.blacklight.reach_1.desc: All weapon reach: 135% of original; extends attack wakes and whips.
upgrade.blacklight.reach_2.desc: All weapon reach: 145% of original; extends attack wakes and whips.
upgrade.blacklight.reach_3.desc: All weapon reach: 155% of original; extends attack wakes and whips.
message.blacklight.sample_already_infect: Use to throw the sample. Shatters and releases the virus within 16 blocks.
message.blacklight.survival_start: Blacklight lead: apprentice snowy cartographers sell research station maps. Press %s to see your progress.
Follow the map cross to a research station. Descend into its laboratory, quarantine and cold storage.
advancement.blacklight.sealed_sample.des: Take a sample from cold storage. Use to throw; shatter at your feet to awaken. Exposure radius: 16 blocks.
hud.blacklight.infected_vision: Infected vision · infected warm / ordinary cool
hud.blacklight.thermal_vision: Thermal vision · life warm / surroundings cold
hud.blacklight.vision_failed: Sensory filter unavailable. Reload resources; see log for details.
screen.blacklight.wheel.morph_ready: Release for full transformation; move or attack to exit
screen.blacklight.wheel.morph_hold: Hold selection for half a second for full transformation
upgrade.blacklight.vitality_2.desc: Increase infected base maximum health to 225. Other health bonuses still stack.
upgrade.blacklight.vitality_3.desc: Increase infected base maximum health to 325. Other health bonuses still stack.
upgrade.blacklight.vitality_4.desc: Increase infected base maximum health to 450. Other health bonuses still stack.
screen.blacklight.stats.notes_value: Opening damage assumes the current form, no charge and a target using the new health scale. Charge and mitigation change actual damage. Native skills use their own hit and combo timings; the attack speed attribute is not their exact rate.
message.blacklight.disguise_missing: Complete a normal mob consumption to obtain an identity.
message.blacklight.disguise_busy: Finish your current action before switching identity.
message.blacklight.disguise_watched: You are being tracked. Escape enemy sight before transforming.
message.blacklight.disguise_revealed: An attack or power revealed your identity.
command.blacklight.infect_mob: Infection started in %s creatures. Models change when mutation completes.
command.blacklight.infected_blocked: Not enough space. Use coordinates in an open area.
command.blacklight.colossus_unknown: Cannot create colossus %s; supported species: warden, iron_golem, wither, ender_dragon.
message.blacklight.colossus_malformed: The hive is feeding %s. Aberrant growth has begun; thin the infected to stop it.
message.blacklight.colossus_cocoon: %s has entered incubation. Destroy the hive or kill its host to prevent a colossus.
message.blacklight.colossus_awakening: %s is awakening! The nearby hive is still sustaining its growth.
message.blacklight.colossus_birth: The colossal %s has awakened in the infected zone!
message.blacklight.disguise_exposed: This identity has been exposed. Break line of sight before switching to an unknown identity.
message.blacklight.disguise_power_body: Returned to your original body to use a visible power. No witnesses, no added alert.
message.blacklight.disguise_known: This identity is still recognized. Break line of sight and wait for pursuit to fade.
upgrade.blacklight.critical_mass.desc: Consume overflow builds the blue Critical Mass reserve. Any positive reserve permits a learned Devastator; missing cost consumes health. Incoming damage spends the reserve first.
upgrade.blacklight.adrenaline_surge.desc: Lethal damage grants 1.8 seconds of survival and one Devastator opportunity. Free releases must be 22.5 seconds apart. Rearms after the window ends and health returns above half. Void and forced death bypass it.
upgrade.blacklight.bulletdive_drop.desc: Charge while gliding and release to accelerate downward. Movement keys steer; release them to guide toward an explicitly locked target. Toggle lock again to cancel. Fall distance increases damage and terrain impact; Settings can disable block breaking. No reserve cost.
upgrade.blacklight.groundspike_graveyard: Erupt bone spikes around you for 2000 base true damage on the primary contact. Spends one Critical Mass or Adrenaline opportunity.
upgrade.blacklight.tendril_barrage.desc: Burst tendrils outward for 1600 base true damage on the primary contact. Spends one Critical Mass or Adrenaline opportunity.
upgrade.blacklight.critical_pain.desc: Focus biomass on the locked target for 4000 base true damage on the primary contact. Spends one Critical Mass or Adrenaline opportunity.
message.blacklight.adrenaline_started: Adrenaline Surge: brief survival and one learned Devastator opportunity!
upgrade.blacklight.critical_mass_boost_1: Store up to two Devastator releases. Each release spends only one charge.
upgrade.blacklight.critical_mass_boost_2: Store up to three Devastator releases. Requires Critical Mass Boost I.
upgrade.blacklight.critical_mass_boost_3: Store up to four Devastator releases. Requires Critical Mass Boost II.
setting.blacklight.bulletdive_blocks.des: Breaks blocks with debris and drops based on the actual fall. Turning this off preserves damage and impact effects. World drop rules apply. Your choice is saved.
upgrade.blacklight.mode.desc: Switch between Blacklight and survival controls after infection. Before infection, apprentice cartographers in snowy villages sell research-station maps; your Advancements page tracks exploration.
upgrade.blacklight.grab.desc: Consume to heal and gain biomass and EP. Normal creatures also grant identities.
upgrade.blacklight.target_lock.desc: A red outline marks your target and assists attack direction and pursuit.
upgrade.blacklight.disguise.desc: Assume a consumed identity and switch between disguise and your true form.
upgrade.blacklight.claws.desc: An innate infected weapon with claw combos and ground spikes.
upgrade.blacklight.groundspike.desc: Plant the claw and erupt piercing spikes. Range upgrades increase coverage. Grants brief startup invulnerability, ending before recovery.
tutorial.blacklight.mode.steps: After infection, enable Blacklight mode for combat and traversal. Toggle again to restore survival interactions.
tutorial.blacklight.consume.steps: Aim at a nearby creature and grab it, then consume or throw. Targets with 50+ maximum health must be weakened to 15% health.
tutorial.blacklight.lock.steps: Face a target and lock on to show its red outline. Press again to release; invalid or distant targets are released.
tutorial.blacklight.disguise.steps: Consume an ordinary creature, then tap the morph key to switch bodies. Hold it to open the independent wheel and select Identities. The collection shows supported abilities and the current ability key.
tutorial.blacklight.jump.controls: Hold [%1$s] to charge → release to jump
tutorial.blacklight.jump.steps: Hold jump on the ground, then release after charging. A standing charge stays planted; a running charge carries momentum.
tutorial.blacklight.sprint.steps: Hold forward and Sprint to build speed. On the ground, hold a direction and press [%3$s] to dodge immediately; without a direction, dodge backward. You can also tap and release Sprint [%2$s] within half a second. Jump still handles normal and charged jumps. Upgrades raise top speed; traversal handles water and small obstacles.
tutorial.blacklight.wall.steps: Run into a wall while sprinting to run upward. Release sprint to climb slowly; sneak detaches. Upgrades increase climbing speed.
tutorial.blacklight.glide.controls: Press and hold [%1$s] again in the air
tutorial.blacklight.glide.steps: Release jump after takeoff, then hold it again while falling to glide. Steer with movement keys. Release to stop; armor prevents gliding.
tutorial.blacklight.dash.controls: Passive upgrade · One additional air dash
tutorial.blacklight.dash.steps: Automatically adds one airborne dash, refreshed on landing. This upgrade has no separate activation key and does not cancel active weapon actions.
tutorial.blacklight.groundspike.steps: Release on the ground. Spikes erupt after the claw plants, then the arm retracts. The range upgrade increases coverage.
tutorial.blacklight.slice.steps: Equip claws and attack while running. Slice and pounce upgrades strengthen movement attacks; leave space ahead.
tutorial.blacklight.claws.steps: Hold the power wheel, select claws and release. Chain attacks or hold to charge; use on the ground plants a spike attack.
tutorial.blacklight.blade.steps: Select the blade in the wheel. Chain slashes, use on the ground to rush, or use airborne to dive with the blade.
tutorial.blacklight.hammer.steps: Equip hammerfists. Chain heavy punches; use to quake on the ground or drop in the air. Sprinting changes the special attack.
tutorial.blacklight.whip.steps: Equip whipfist for ranged lashes and longshots. Combo specials sweep; grab pulls valid targets from up to 12 blocks away.
tutorial.blacklight.muscle.steps: Equip muscle mass, then alternate attacks and specials to chain punches and kicks. Throws are also strengthened.
tutorial.blacklight.armor.steps: Select armor in the wheel; defense toggles the last selected defense. Armor reduces speed and disables gliding.
tutorial.blacklight.shield.steps: Select shield and face incoming attacks. Toggle your last defense; a broken shield must recover, and toggling does not refill it.
tutorial.blacklight.vision.steps: Select thermal or infected vision in the wheel. Senses toggles your last selection. Visions are mutually exclusive but coexist with weapons and defense.
tutorial.blacklight.critical.steps: Excess healing from consumption fills the blue reserve after the health bar. Any positive reserve permits a learned devastator; missing cost uses health. Passive upgrade.
tutorial.blacklight.health.steps: Applies automatically after purchase. Health upgrades raise maximum health; regeneration requires time without taking damage. See the exact effect below.
tutorial.blacklight.reach.steps: Automatically extends weapon reach and its visual effect after purchase. No separate activation.
tutorial.blacklight.adrenaline.steps: Briefly prevents death and grants one learned devastator opportunity. Cast or recover health before the window ends; cooldown and rearming rules are listed below.
tutorial.blacklight.dive.steps: While falling, hold jump again to glide. Hold use to charge, then release to dive. Greater fall distance means more power and a deeper crater; red mist appears above 50 blocks. No critical reserve cost.
tutorial.blacklight.graveyard.steps: Requires this skill and positive blue reserve or an adrenaline opportunity. Hold through the charge, then release. Spikes erupt outward and retract; also usable in the air.
tutorial.blacklight.barrage.steps: Requires this skill and reserve or an adrenaline opportunity. Hold through the charge and release; tendrils expand in all directions and retract. Also usable airborne.
tutorial.blacklight.pain.steps: Requires this skill and reserve or an adrenaline opportunity. Aim first, hold through the charge and release a focused forward attack, followed by retraction.
upgrade.blacklight.shield_borer.desc: Sprint forward with a deployed shield to break blocks about 1.5 blocks ahead, up to 6 per tick, with normal drops. Enable Shield Borer Block Breaking in Settings. Preserves support surfaces and respects server protection.
tutorial.blacklight.shield_borer.steps: Unlock Shield and Shield Borer, enable Shield Borer Block Breaking in Settings, then select and deploy your shield and sprint forward on the ground. Boosts I and II increase reach and break rate. Stops when disabled, sprint released or shield retracted/broken. The demo shows the shield-running stance; destruction is server-authoritative and pauses under load.
Increases forward excavation reach to about 2 blocks and the limit to 9 breaks per tick. Requires Shield Borer. Does not increase corridor height or excavate the floor.
Increases forward excavation reach to about 2.5 blocks and the limit to 12 breaks per tick. Requires Boost I. Pauses under server load and continues to respect protection.
setting.blacklight.prototype_item_pickup: On by default. Disable automatic pickup of dropped items in Prototype mode; items remain on the ground. Normal mode pickup and experience orbs are unaffected. Saved per player across sessions and death.
setting.blacklight.shield_borer_blocks.d: Off by default. Enable to excavate while sprinting forward with a deployed shield and the learned Shield Borer skill. Disable to sprint without excavation; learned levels are retained. Saved per player, independently of Bulletdive settings.
screen.blacklight.wheel.biomass: Separate into a controllable viral aggregate and absorb a creature to rebuild. Scroll to select; release the key to confirm.
screen.blacklight.morph_hint: Scroll to select · Release %1$s to confirm · Esc / right click to cancel
message.blacklight.biomass_blocked_shell: Clear standing room above your husk before recalling.
upgrade.blacklight.biomass.desc: Hold morph and choose viral aggregate on the special wheel, leaving a husk for free. Fatal damage instead spends 150 biomass by default to enter viral aggregate recovery with no husk; insufficient biomass means normal death. Approach edible prey, climb and consume it to rebuild. Aggregate size and viral stability can be upgraded.
tutorial.blacklight.biomass.controls: Hold %1$s for the morph wheel, scroll to viral aggregate form and release. Move with %2$s. Tap %1$s to recall a voluntary separation.
screen.blacklight.morph_fatal: Post-mortem viral aggregate: consume a creature to recover your body
tutorial.blacklight.biomass.steps: The viral aggregate flows and trails with movement, then climbs onto nearby prey. Default natural decay lasts 45 seconds. Voluntary expiry attempts recall; fatal form must consume before expiry. Death form may convert natural ground to tissue; the server can disable this.
message.blacklight.biomass_need_prey: Consume a creature to revive from your post-mortem viral aggregate.
message.blacklight.biomass_recalled: Returned to your husk. Viral aggregate form ended.
message.blacklight.biomass_no_shell: The husk is unloaded, in another dimension or destroyed. Return nearby or consume a creature.
message.blacklight.biomass_reforming: Reforming after consumption. Crawl into open space if blocked.
upgrade.blacklight.block_throw_1.desc: Musclemass only. Base direct-hit damage 12–22; level and charge increase launch speed, range and knockback. Full charge takes 1.5 seconds. Actual range depends on angle, terrain and water.
upgrade.blacklight.block_throw_2.desc: Musclemass only. Base direct-hit damage 18–34; level and charge increase launch speed, range and knockback. Full charge takes 1.5 seconds. Actual range depends on angle, terrain and water.
upgrade.blacklight.block_throw_3.desc: Musclemass only. Base direct-hit damage 26–50; level and charge increase launch speed, range and knockback. Full charge takes 1.5 seconds. Actual range depends on angle, terrain and water.
tutorial.blacklight.block_throw.controls: Musclemass: with no grabbable creature, hold %1$s to grow a connected terrain selection; release to lift. Hold %2$s to charge, release to throw; %3$s drops it. While carrying, hold %4$s for manual aim.
tutorial.blacklight.block_throw.steps: Selection grows randomly from the targeted block through connected neighbors, up to 4 / 8 / 27 blocks by tier. Actual size selects one or two hands. Lifting removes the source blocks. Larger cargo flies slower but hits harder. Full charge: 1.5 seconds. Aim assist adjusts launch only; gravity and drag apply without a trajectory overlay.
hud.blacklight.terrain_select: %s blocks selected · release Grab to lift
message.blacklight.terrain_grab_unavaila: This block cannot be grabbed or is protected
message.blacklight.terrain_grab_out_of_r: No block within reach. Move closer and aim at the terrain.
message.blacklight.biomass_expired: Your viral aggregate has collapsed before rebuilding a body.
hud.blacklight.slime_fatal: Viral aggregate · approach prey to rebuild
hud.blacklight.slime_voluntary: Viral aggregate · approach prey / tap morph to recall
tutorial.blacklight.slime.controls: Buy sequential upgrades with EP in Biology. Applies to both voluntary and fatal viral aggregate forms.
tutorial.blacklight.slime.steps: Size expands the body and contact reach. Viral stability increases the 45-second lifespan to 75 / 120 seconds, then removes natural decay. Damage still applies. Only death conversion spends biomass; voluntary separation and learned skills are free.
upgrade.blacklight.slime_size_1.desc: Body dimensions scale to 1.25x, including visuals, collision and contact reach. Costs 300 EP.
upgrade.blacklight.slime_size_2.desc: Body dimensions scale to 1.5x, including visuals, collision and contact reach. Costs 600 EP.
upgrade.blacklight.slime_size_3.desc: Body dimensions scale to 1.8x, including visuals, collision and contact reach. Costs 900 EP.
upgrade.blacklight.slime_decay_1.desc: Natural decay lasts 75 seconds. Costs 300 EP.
upgrade.blacklight.slime_decay_2.desc: Natural decay lasts 120 seconds. Costs 600 EP.
upgrade.blacklight.slime_decay_3.desc: No natural decay; incoming damage still applies. Costs 1200 EP.
upgrade.blacklight.adaptation.desc: Passive: reduction percent = ceil(100 * stacks / (stacks + current HP)). Gain ceil(actual damage / 6) stacks, at least 1 for an effective hit. Spend ceil(10% of prevented damage), at least 1. Stacks cannot fall below zero and have no timed decay.
upgrade.blacklight.adaptation_percent.de: Use ceil(current HP / maximum HP * 100), at least 1, in Adaptation's denominator. Round the reduction percent up too. At 10/1000 HP, use 1: 99 stacks provide 99% reduction. Stack gain and consumption rules are unchanged.
upgrade.blacklight.tissue_regeneration.d: Gain ceil(actual damage / 6) stacks, at least 1 for an effective hit. Every 20 ticks, heal HP equal to current stacks. Spend ceil(20% of HP actually restored), at least 1. The final stacks can reach zero.
message.blacklight.passive_already_owned: This passive is already permanent. No additional drink is needed.
tooltip.blacklight.passive_serum: Legacy bottle: requires Adaptive Passives. Permanent through death; does not unlock Blacklight skills.
tutorial.blacklight.adaptation.steps: Passive: reduction percent = ceil(100 * stacks / (stacks + current HP)). Gain ceil(actual damage / 6) stacks, at least 1 for an effective hit. Spend ceil(10% of prevented damage), at least 1. Stacks cannot fall below zero and have no timed decay.
tutorial.blacklight.adaptation_percent.s: Use ceil(current HP / maximum HP * 100), at least 1, in Adaptation's denominator. Round the reduction percent up too. At 10/1000 HP, use 1: 99 stacks provide 99% reduction. Stack gain and consumption rules are unchanged.
Gain ceil(actual damage / 6) stacks, at least 1 for an effective hit. Every 20 ticks, heal HP equal to current stacks. Spend ceil(20% of HP actually restored), at least 1. The final stacks can reach zero.
message.blacklight.passive_moved: Potions moved to Adaptive Passives. Install it to use this legacy bottle.
setting.blacklight.passive_stacks.desc: Local Blacklight skill HUD only. Does not change passive effects or the independent potion HUD.
city.blacklight.legacy_welcome: Legacy Futian city dimension. Use the beacon or /blacklightcity travel to return.
city.blacklight.welcome: Blacklight Dimension · Futian, Shenzhen. Use the beacon or /blacklightcity travel to return. Destroy all seven exterior hatcheries to disable a civic-centre hive.
city.blacklight.hive_destroyed: Hive disabled: production and spread stopped. Existing infected remain.
city.blacklight.unavailable: City dimension unavailable. Restart the server and try again.
city.blacklight.no_safe_exit: No safe ground near the return point. Use another travel method.
upgrade.blacklight.kinetic_reflection.de: Spend EP repeatedly with no designed level cap to increase frontal shield and full-body armor reflection capacity and reflected damage. Successful deflections deal no health damage and cause only local vibration. Overloads trigger a loaded guard: shields absorb damage using durability, with only overflow reaching health; armor retains 47.5% resistance. Speed affects impact strength. Unlock shield or armor first.
screen.blacklight.ricochet_stats:
Level: %s
Shield capacity: %s
Armor capacity: %s
Reflected damage: ×%s
Next level: %s EP
upgrade.blacklight.sovereign_wings.desc: A winged Blacklight form compatible with weapons.
tutorial.blacklight.sovereign_wings.cont: Hold %1$s, then TAB for basic abilities; %2$s launch / ascend, %3$s descend, %4$s boost.
tutorial.blacklight.sovereign_wings.step: Select Sovereign Wings on the second ability-wheel page. Walk and run normally on the ground; %2$s launches. Use %5$s and the mouse to steer freely; release movement to hover. Hold %3$s to land, or select the wings again to retract.
screen.blacklight.wheel.sovereign_wings: Grow wings from your back; select again to retract
upgrade.blacklight.wing_speed_1.desc: Wing upgrade: sustained forward sprint reaches 80 blocks/s. Normal cruise retains precise control. Release sprint to brake; actual speed adapts smoothly to the loaded terrain ahead: faster loading permits faster flight.
upgrade.blacklight.wing_speed_2.desc: Wing upgrade: sustained forward sprint reaches 200 blocks/s. Normal cruise retains precise control. Release sprint to brake; actual speed adapts smoothly to the loaded terrain ahead: faster loading permits faster flight.
upgrade.blacklight.wing_speed_3.desc: Wing upgrade: sustained forward sprint reaches 440 blocks/s. Normal cruise retains precise control. Release sprint to brake; actual speed adapts smoothly to the loaded terrain ahead: faster loading permits faster flight. Cross 343 blocks/s for a sonic boom, condensation and swept-wing flight.
hydra.blacklight.planted: Tissue planted. Bring creatures to its roots. Approach when mature to enter Blacklight; sneak to avoid capture.
hydra.blacklight.arrived: Passage linked. Approach this Hydra to return; sneak to avoid capture.
hydra.blacklight.wait: Destination is not ready. Approach again shortly.
hydra.blacklight.outside: Grow tissue outside Blacklight to establish a two-way Hydra passage.
hydra.blacklight.tooltip.1: Plant on a solid surface outside Blacklight.
hydra.blacklight.tooltip.2: Feed 5 creatures and allow 2 minutes of loaded growth.
hydra.blacklight.tooltip.3: Approach when mature to travel; the other Hydra brings you back.
advancement.blacklight.hydra_tissue.desc: Plant hive tissue, feed five creatures and let it mature into a two-way Hydra passage.
building.blacklight.site_unavailable: This site is occupied, cleared, protected, or the server colony limit was reached.
building.blacklight.status: Infection stage %s/4 · Active growth %s%% · %s attached blocks
setting.blacklight.health_hud.desc: Move the health meter, critical mass and recovery status together.
setting.blacklight.wing_speed.desc: Choose 10%–100% of unlocked speed. Loaded-chunk safety limits still apply.
upgrade.blacklight.assimilation_2.desc: Consume large targets at 25% health, restore 170% of base consume healing and envelop in 1.8 seconds. Mature tissue still requires organ fracture.
tutorial.blacklight.assimilation_2.steps: Consume large targets at 25% health, restore 170% of base consume healing and envelop in 1.8 seconds. Mature tissue still requires organ fracture.
upgrade.blacklight.slime_mobility_1.desc: Crawl faster while retaining normal block collision.
tutorial.blacklight.slime_mobility_1.ste: Crawl faster while retaining normal block collision.
upgrade.blacklight.slime_mobility_3.desc: Greatly increase crawl speed for repositioning and finding prey.
tutorial.blacklight.slime_mobility_3.ste: Greatly increase crawl speed for repositioning and finding prey.
upgrade.blacklight.biomass_metabolism.de: While wounded in Prototype mode, spend 10 biomass each second to restore 2% maximum health (at least 1 base point). Creates no critical mass and does not work in liquid form.
tutorial.blacklight.biomass_metabolism.s: While wounded in Prototype mode, spend 10 biomass each second to restore 2% maximum health (at least 1 base point). Creates no critical mass and does not work in liquid form.
screen.blacklight.identity_empty: Consume an ordinary creature to collect its appearance. Existing saves also keep their current identity.
screen.blacklight.identity_note: Newest first; up to 64 distinct appearances. Switching cannot reset the shared cooldown. Attacks and witnessed transformations expose identities.
message.blacklight.disguise_selection_st: The collection changed. Open it again to select an identity.
message.blacklight.species_conditions: Ability conditions are not met. Check its collection description.
species.blacklight.none.desc: Preserves appearance and camouflage relationships. No active ability adapter exists for this species yet; arbitrary mod AI is never copied.
species.blacklight.climb.desc: Face a solid wall within 1.2 blocks and press the ability key to climb upward. Repeat to keep climbing.
species.blacklight.flap.desc: Flap upward and forward. Falling is slowed in the air. Does not grant creative flight; unavailable in water or lava.
species.blacklight.leap.desc: Jump high in the viewing direction while grounded. Cannot leap again in midair.
species.blacklight.swim.desc: Breathe underwater. Press the ability key in water to dash in the viewing direction.
species.blacklight.blink.desc: Move up to 8 blocks along your view. Cannot pass solid walls, cross the world border or enter unloaded chunks.
species.blacklight.arrow.desc: Fire an actual player-owned arrow along your aim. Normal collision and protection rules apply. These arrows cannot be picked up.
species.blacklight.fireball.desc: Fire an actual player-owned small fireball along your aim, respecting fire and area protection rules.
species.blacklight.explode.desc: Explode around yourself. The blast spares its source and leaves terrain intact, but exposes your identity.
species.blacklight.fireproof: This identity also resists fire damage.
city.blacklight.los_angeles_welcome: Blacklight Dimension · Los Angeles. /blacklightcity losangeles places lists district entrances. Use the transit beacon or /blacklightcity travel to return.
city.blacklight.destinations: Cities: Los Angeles /blacklightcity losangeles; Shenzhen /blacklightcity shenzhen. Return to your original world: /blacklightcity travel.
city.blacklight.destinations_hint: Legacy operator debugging item. Survival travel uses a mature hydra.
message.blacklight.outbreak_started: Blacklight has been released. World infection is now progressing; mature infected will appear over time.
upgrade.blacklight.infinite_vitality.des: Maximum HP per rank follows server configuration. Purchases preserve health fraction; current and next-rank effects appear below.
upgrade.blacklight.infinite_strength.des: Native ordinary attack strength follows the configured per-rank coefficient. See current and next-rank effects below.
Native Blacklight skills, Devastators and Bulletdive follow the configured per-rank skill coefficient.
upgrade.blacklight.infinite_resilience.d: Defense uses the server coefficient and has no rank limit. Void and administrative kills are excluded.
upgrade.blacklight.infinite_recovery.des: Out-of-combat delay and actual healing per rank follow server configuration. Death biomass still requires consumption.
upgrade.blacklight.infinite_mobility.des: Walking and ground sprint use the configured logarithmic coefficient. Animation and wing-beat speed are unchanged.
message.blacklight.passive_qualification: Every core infinite attribute must reach rank %s before this passive can be learned.
screen.blacklight.evolution_unlocked: Infinite evolution qualified · Future cities will not relock it
screen.blacklight.evolution_curriculum_d: Complete the finite curriculum to invest. Existing ranks are saved but inactive until qualified. Final passives and repeatable upgrades are excluded.
screen.blacklight.evolution_more: %s more requirements remain in their skill categories.
screen.blacklight.passive_requirement: Every core infinite attribute requires rank %s
city.blacklight.los_angeles_places: Los Angeles districts: downtown, hollywood, van_nuys, lax, venice, san_pedro. Use /blacklightcity losangeles <district>.
city.blacklight.loading_timeout: The destination is still loading. Travel cancelled; try again shortly.
building.blacklight.supply_status: Stage %s/4 · Maturity %s%% · Tissue %s · Nutrients %s · Digesting %s portions
city.blacklight.hive_supply_status: Hive · live mouths %s/7 · nutrients %s · digesting %s · brood %s%%
setting.blacklight.infection_zones.desc: Show the server-owned Green, Yellow or Red zone label. Hiding it does not change infection or population.
setting.blacklight.wing_appearance.desc: Choose classic or precision wings. Your choice applies immediately, is saved, and is visible to other players. Both share flight abilities and upgrades.
upgrade.blacklight.tissue_regeneration_p: Every 20 ticks, heal current stacks percent of missing HP, up to maximum health. Gain stacks from actual damage / 6 rounded up. Spend 20% of HP actually restored rounded up, at least 1 stack.
tutorial.blacklight.tissue_regeneration_: Every 20 ticks, heal current stacks percent of missing HP, up to maximum health. Gain stacks from actual damage / 6 rounded up. Spend 20% of HP actually restored rounded up, at least 1 stack.
city.blacklight.sac_hint: Decorative infected tissue. Does not hatch creatures on its own.
command.blacklight.base.placed: Placed %s base [%s], %s x %s blocks. Garrisons arrive within the population budget.
tooltip.blacklight.vehicle.place: Places a complete vehicle, initially without ammunition; driving requires no fuel
tooltip.blacklight.vehicle.supply: Stop and dismount, then right-click the vehicle with matching ammunition or repair parts
tooltip.blacklight.autocannon_round: Stop and dismount, then right-click an armored vehicle with this item to load autocannon ammunition
command.blacklight.military.value: Invalid size, rank, faction, preset or order arguments.
command.blacklight.military.unit: Unit not found; use its name or UUID.
tooltip.blacklight.firearm_controls: Use to fire; sneak + use to reload from inventory
message.blacklight.firearm_empty: Empty or loading; sneak + use to reload
command.blacklight.base.refused: Base placement refused: %s. The entire 18-block-high volume must be clear of buildings, fluids and containers.
tooltip.blacklight.tank_he_shell: Stop and dismount, then right-click a tank with this item to load HE shells
tooltip.blacklight.military_fuel_can: Reserved item, currently inactive; vehicles do not require fuel
command.blacklight.military.members: Selected members have an incompatible faction, state or assignment; organization unchanged.
command.blacklight.military.operation: Operation conflicts with capacity, hierarchy or appointment rules; organization unchanged.
tooltip.blacklight.tank_ap_shell: Stop and dismount, then right-click a tank with this item to load AP shells
tooltip.blacklight.vehicle_repair_parts: Stop and dismount, then right-click a vehicle with repair parts to repair it
hud.blacklight.vehicle_supply_hint: Supply: stop, dismount, right-click the hull with matching ammunition or repair parts
campaign.blacklight.base_destroyed: %s command facilities destroyed: local reinforcements and base production stopped.
campaign.blacklight.infiltration_started: %s infiltration assigned: consume an officer of this base to disrupt support.
campaign.blacklight.infiltration_complet: %s infiltration complete: command and reinforcements temporarily disabled.
